remarks: Bright and spacious one-bedroom, one-bathroom ranch-style apartment on the first floor. Enjoy a large living room, an eat-in kitchen, and a generously sized bedroom with beautiful hardwood floors throughout. Common laundry is available in the basement for your convenience. Heat and hot water are included in the common charges, so you can stay comfortable year-round without worry. Ideally located near I-95 (Exit 9), Chelsea Pier, the train station, and a variety of shops and restaurants. Excellent credit is required.
